title: HELIX Terminology: Veteran Status
description: Military/veteran classification for benefits eligibility and reporting.

codes.definition: Former member of the armed forces who has been discharged
Currently serving in the armed forces
Member of a reserve component or National Guard
Dependent or spouse of a service member, eligible for benefits (e.g., Chapter 35, MyCAA)

notes: US-specific. Drives VA benefits eligibility (GI Bill chapters), IPEDS Military Servicemember reporting, and state veteran tuition waivers. International profiles should define country-specific military/veteran codes.
